files.README.md:
# sample-portfolio

This candidate contains synthetic data for learning the computation contract. Its numbers, thresholds and dates do not describe real entities or current rules. It is not a registered built-in pack.

The declaration selects normalized records and their hash-bound structured views. `records.json` is illustrative input data; matching this JSON file alone does not make it normalized evidence. Use your registered normalization workflow to retain it as a structured source before computing.

Read `docs/declarative-computation.md` in the workspace for the language and operation boundaries.
files.research.overlay.yml:
domain_pack:
  name: sample-portfolio
  version: 1.0.0
  compatible_research_yml_contract: '0.1'
  human_gated: true
computation:
  version: '1.0'
  arithmetic:
    mode: exact
    precision: 64
    scale: 2
    rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN
  clock:
    as_of: '2026-09-21T12:00:00Z'
    timezone: UTC
    ambiguous: refuse
    nonexistent: refuse
    search_days: 366
  tables: {}
  aggregations:
    positions:
      description: Synthetic observations
      selector:
        source_glob: sources/normalized/*.md
        records_pointer: /records
        row_key: /id
        allow_empty: false
      filter: null
      group_by:
      - record.asset_class
      metrics:
        exposure:
          op: sum
          expr: record.notional
          denominator: null
          unit: units
        pnl:
          op: sum
          expr: record.pnl
          denominator: null
          unit: units
      output_target: null
  graphs:
    portfolio:
      description: Synthetic worksheet
      inputs:
        exposure:
          kind: aggregation
          id: positions
          metric: exposure
          group: null
          reduce: sum
        pnl:
          kind: aggregation
          id: positions
          metric: pnl
          group: null
          reduce: sum
      constants:
        limit:
          value: '1000000'
          unit: units
      nodes:
        utilization:
          expr: exposure / constants.limit
          unit: ratio
      output_mapping:
        exposure: exposure
        pnl: pnl
        utilization: utilization
      output_page: null
  invariants:
    limit:
      description: Declared synthetic constraint
      target: computed
      selector: null
      inputs:
        exposure:
          kind: aggregation
          id: positions
          metric: exposure
          group: null
          reduce: sum
      filter: null
      assertion: exposure <= 1000000
      severity: error
      failure_message: Declared constraint requires review.
  cadence:
    review:
      description: Synthetic event rule
      trigger:
        type: condition
        expression: exposure > 1000000
        inputs:
          exposure:
            kind: aggregation
            id: positions
            metric: exposure
            group: null
            reduce: sum
      lead_alerts: []
      action:
        kind: check_invariants
        target: limit
